content:
{'translation': "The iPhone Duo is the name of Apple's new foldable phone, arguably the most anticipated model since the original iPhone. Here are some iPhone Duo details you may have missed.", 'source': 'iPhone Duo 是 Apple 新款摺疊手機嘅名稱，堪稱自初代 iPhone 以來最令人期待嘅新型號。以下係一啲你可能錯過嘅 iPhone Duo 細節。'}

{'translation': "iPhone Duo details from Apple's launch event and official website", 'source': 'Apple 發佈會及官網上嘅 iPhone Duo 細節'}

{'translation': "Apple's first foldable iPhone made its official debut today and will be available for pre-order next month.", 'source': 'Apple 首款摺疊 iPhone 今日正式亮相，並將於下月開放預訂。'}

{'translation': "If you're looking to buy a new iPhone, you might be very interested in the Duo, but aren't sure if it's the right fit.", 'source': '如果你想買新 iPhone，可能對 Duo 非常感興趣，但又不確定啱唔啱自己。'}

{'translation': "The iPhone Duo's main selling point is pretty clear: it's a foldable device with dual screens, excellent cameras and battery life, plus the various benefits its unique form factor brings.", 'source': 'iPhone Duo 嘅主打功能相當明確：佢係一款摺疊機，配備雙螢幕、出色嘅相機及電池續航力，加上獨特機身設計帶來嘅多項優勢。'}

{'translation': "However, at today's launch event and on Apple's website afterwards, quite a few smaller iPhone Duo details were also revealed.", 'source': '不過，喺今日嘅發佈會以及之後嘅 Apple 官網上，亦都披露咗唔少較細嘅 iPhone Duo 細節。'}

{'translation': 'Cameras', 'source': '相機功能'}

  • {'translation': 'Software exclusives: The iPhone Duo comes with several camera software exclusives, such as Smart Take, Kid Cue and Duo Preview. But most notably, its main lens lacks the variable aperture feature found on the iPhone 18 Pro.', 'source': '軟件獨家功能：iPhone Duo 配備多項軟件獨家相機功能，例如 Smart Take、Kid Cue 及 Duo Preview。但最值得留意嘅係，佢嘅主鏡頭並無 iPhone 18 Pro 嘅可變光圈功能。'}
  • {'translation': "Under-display camera: The iPhone Duo's folding screen features an under-display camera — a first for the iPhone — meaning the inner screen has no cutout at all.", 'source': '螢幕下相機：iPhone Duo 嘅摺疊螢幕配備螢幕下相機，係 iPhone 上首次採用，內螢幕因此完全冇開孔。'}
  • {'translation': "Big difference in selfie cameras: The under-display camera on the inner screen is far inferior in quality to the Center Stage front-facing camera on the outer screen, so it's recommended to use the outer screen camera for selfies whenever possible.", 'source': '前置自拍鏡頭差異大：內螢幕嘅螢幕下相機質素遠遜於外螢幕嘅 Center Stage 前置鏡頭，所以建議盡量使用外螢幕嘅相機自拍。'}

{'translation': 'Buttons', 'source': '按鍵'}

{'translation': 'The iPhone Duo features a Camera Control button, but lacks the Action button that has been a staple on other iPhone models for years.', 'source': 'iPhone Duo 設有相機控制按鍵，但就冇咗其他 iPhone 型號沿用多年嘅動作按鍵。'}

{'translation': 'Display', 'source': '螢幕'}

{'translation': "Only the iPhone Duo's folding display offers a nano-texture coating option; the outer screen does not have this option.", 'source': '只有 iPhone Duo 嘅摺疊螢幕提供 nano-texture 塗層選項，外螢幕並無此選項。'}

{'translation': 'Apple Pencil', 'source': 'Apple Pencil'}

{'translation': 'Apple says the iPhone Duo will support Apple Pencil later this year, usable on both the inner and outer screens. However, only the USB-C Pencil model is currently supported; Apple Pencil Pro is not.', 'source': 'Apple 表示 iPhone Duo 將於今年稍後時間支援 Apple Pencil，內外兩塊螢幕均可使用。不過，目前只支援配備 USB-C 嘅 Pencil 型號，並未支援 Apple Pencil Pro。'}

{'translation': 'Release date', 'source': '發售日期'}

{'translation': "Unlike the iPhone 18 Pro, which goes on sale later this week, the iPhone Duo won't be available for pre-order until October 16, with shipping beginning a week later on October 23.", 'source': '與本週稍後開賣嘅 iPhone 18 Pro 不同，iPhone Duo 要到 10 月 16 日先可以預訂，並於一週後嘅 10 月 23 日正式發貨。'}

{'translation': 'iOS 27.1', 'source': 'iOS 27.1'}

{'translation': "This really isn't surprising, given that the iPhone Duo doesn't ship until late October. Apple says the new device will come with iOS 27.1 pre-installed.", 'source': '呢一點其實都唔令人意外，因為 iPhone Duo 要到 10 月底先出貨。Apple 表示新機將預載 iOS 27.1 系統。'}

{'translation': 'eSIM only', 'source': '僅支援 eSIM'}

{'translation': 'Top liked comment: Oblyvion', 'source': '最多讚好留言：Oblyvion'}

{'translation': "Although not specifically about the Duo, one feature was briefly mentioned — they'll be rolling out the ability to pair multiple iPhones with the same phone number. I think the timing makes sense, because users who want the best of both worlds and own both a Pro and a Duo would find the Pro's camera quality far superior to the Duo's.", 'source': '雖然唔係特別針對 Duo，但有一項功能被簡短提及——佢哋將推出用同一個電話號碼配對多部 iPhone 嘅功能。我認為呢個時機推出好合理，因為想「兩全其美」、同時擁有 Pro 同 Duo 嘅用戶，Pro 嘅相機質素遠勝 Duo。'}

{'translation': "There's no way to buy an iPhone Duo with a physical SIM card anywhere in the world. Even in China, where most users prefer physical SIM cards, the iPhone Duo will only be available in an eSIM version.", 'source': '喺全球任何地方都買唔到配備實體 SIM 卡嘅 iPhone Duo。即使喺大部分用戶偏好實體 SIM 卡嘅中國，iPhone Duo 都只會推出 eSIM 版本。'}

{'translation': 'Which iPhone Duo details caught your attention the most? Feel free to share in the comments.', 'source': 'iPhone Duo 邊啲細節最引起你注意？歡迎喺留言區分享。'}

{'translation': "For more coverage of Apple's launch event, please visit our dedicated news hub.", 'source': '想了解更多 Apple 發佈會嘅報導，請瀏覽我哋嘅專題新聞中心。'}
